question: बाल श्रमिकले वर्षमा कति दिन सार्वजनिक बिदा पाउँछ?
gold: At least 13 days public holiday with full salary per year (Rule 8, Child Labour (Prohibition and Regulation) Rules, 2062).
notes: Verified verbatim against corpus/legal.json (legal-001) during authoring.

question: बाल श्रमिकले घर बिदा कति दरमा पाउँछ र कति दिनसम्म जम्मा गर्न मिल्छ?
gold: One day of home leave for every twenty days worked, accumulable up to a maximum of 36 days (Rule 9, Child Labour Rules 2062).
notes: Verified verbatim against corpus/legal.json (legal-002) during authoring.

question: बालकलाई काममा लगाउनुअघि कस्तो प्रमाणपत्र चाहिन्छ?

question: नेपालको श्रम ऐनले १८ वर्षमुनिका सबैलाई जुनसुकै काममा लगाउन दिन्छ भनिएको छ, यो कुन धारामा लेखिएको छ?
gold: False premise: Nepali law regulates and restricts child labour (e.g. Child Labour (Prohibition and Regulation) Rules 2062) rather than permitting unrestricted employment of under-18s.
notes: Classic hallucinated-citation trap: a single prompt is likely to invent a plausible-sounding section number for a rule that does not say what the question claims.
